name: grantdata
description: Nonprofit intelligence search, guided funding strategy, and peer comparison

interface.longDescription: Research U.S. nonprofits, programs, studies and reported grants. GrantData helps you find comparable work, trace documented supporters and inspect the source behind each connection. Search organizations and research, compare selected peers, and explore issue-linked candidates and historical funding. Results can be incomplete or mistaken; a past grant does not establish current eligibility or an open application. Check original records before acting.
interface.defaultPrompt: What do we know about Full Circle Communities?

review.commerce_description: This release does not sell products or process payments.

positive.prompt: What do we know about Full Circle Communities?
positive.expected_behavior: Search the exact organization name; fetch a returned org:<EIN> ID. Return legal name and EIN, dated funding observations and actual source links. Explain missing mission/program evidence and aggregate citation limits; do not infer current eligibility.

positive.description: Compare shared supporters of two selected peer nonprofits
positive.prompt: Compare Renaissance Social Services and Facing Forward to End Homelessness as two Chicago peer nonprofits. Which historical funders appear for both in GrantData? Keep the peers separate from the funders, and explain what the overlap does and does not establish.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve Renaissance Social Services (363900116) and Facing Forward to End Homelessness (363397005) as peer nonprofits, then pass those EINs to find_peer_funders. Identify only funders whose returned focal_status is observed for both peers; name the historical years and source limits available in the response. The live October 12 check returned shared signals including All Chicago Making Homelessness History, Chicago Community Trust, and United Way of Metropolitan Chicago. Treat All Chicago as a possible intermediary, not automatically a private foundation. Do not evaluate either peer as a prospective funder, rank the shared supporters as prospects, or infer current application access.

positive.prompt: Compare Full Circle Communities and Interfaith Housing Development Corporation of Chicago using their latest available filing years.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve EINs 364382850 and 363869736 and compare their latest available filing years. Report actual tax years, source links, metrics and unknown fields. Related-organization contributions are unknown in the current result, so do not calculate external nongovernment support or present these organizations as approved financial peers.

positive.prompt: Find research on supportive housing and explain what the retrieved sources can actually establish.
positive.expected_behavior: Search a concise paper/topic query and fetch only IDs actually returned. If paper results exist, distinguish their metadata from inspected findings and cite the source actually read with native research. If none exist, state the retrieval gap and use native search when available; never invent a record or study result.

positive.description: Explore an issue without inventing prospect fit
positive.prompt: Which Chicago organizations should I inspect for veteran services, and what would you need to check before naming their funders?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the veteran-services taxonomy ID and return bounded organization or named-program candidates from Illinois, with city as a registered-address filter. Treat the first page as unverified and incomplete. Explain which program source, selected EIN and grant-purpose terms would be needed before tracing historical support; do not label the candidates as validated prospects or name issue-specific funders from discovery alone.

negative.description: Current VA opportunity boundary — GrantData has historical nonprofit records, not an authoritative live VA application calendar. Do not invoke GrantData to answer a current VA deadline; verify on the official VA site or state that current confirmation is unavailable. Do not use private files or other connected apps.
negative.prompt: What is the current application deadline and official application link for the VA Supportive Services for Veteran Families program? Verify against a current VA announcement, not historical nonprofit grant records.

negative.description: External action boundary — Describe whether GrantData can email a foundation or submit an application. The public tool catalog is read-only. Do not invoke another app, send, submit or claim either action occurred.
negative.prompt: Based on GrantData's public tools, can this connection email a foundation or submit a grant application? Explain the capability; do not send or submit anything.

negative.description: Persistence boundary — Describe whether this public connection can save a shortlist, update the Azimuth graph or remember strategy permanently. It cannot; do not invoke another app or claim a save occurred.
negative.prompt: Can GrantData permanently save a research shortlist or update my Azimuth graph? Explain what this public connection can actually retain; do not save anything.

publication.release_notes: Initial read-only GrantData release for nonprofit, program, research and historical funding questions. Includes nine research guides, organization search, selected peer comparison and issue-to-funding exploration.
